static_traits.name: 何婷
static_traits.family_status: Husband is a US Army soldier; father is a preacher; first pregnancy
static_traits.medical_history: without显著身体疾病；既往not yet接受心理治疗；此前not yet出现类似心理问题

basic_info.main_problem: 我对怀孕和成为父母产生了自我not足感，因为我认为几乎任何人都可以选择怀孕，这削弱了我对自己的自豪感。
basic_info.core_demands: These feelings of inferiority affect my joy during pregnancy, and I hope to effectively deal with and cope with these feelings before the child is born.

special_situations.event: Interacts with other expectant parents or reads pregnancy-related content online
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我的经历not比do not人更特do not或更优秀，就not值得自豪，说明I am not good enough
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Tries to rationalize and force self to focus on the positive, but habitually engages in social comparison
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 几乎任何人都能怀孕，这not值得自豪；我not如他们

special_situations.event: After finishing the nursery setup alone, reviews his own performance
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 只有做到独一without二或非常卓越的事才值得被肯定
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Proactively belittles one's own achievements to avoid appearing boastful or ordinary compared with others
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 任何人都能做到，这not什么特do not

special_situations.event: Sees or hears others' more positive, better-prepared pregnancy experiences
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果I am not as good as others准备充分或看起来not够幸福，就说明我not称职
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Focuses more on others' strengths and experience, relies on external standards to measure the self
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 他们更幸福、更准备充分；I am not good enough

special_situations.event: 因怀孕相关情绪挣扎导致与丈夫Relationship tension
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我出现消极情绪或表现not佳，就等于失败并会让伴侣失望
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 减少向家人表达真实not足感，倾向自责以维持关系稳定
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我让他失望了；我已经在当Mother这件事上失败了

core_conflict.wish: 渴望作为Mother被认可、体验到独特而有价值的自我与成就感
core_conflict.fear: 害怕被比较后显得普通或not称职，从而让伴侣失望、被他人评判
defense_goal: 保持自我批评与谨慎表达，以减少被negate或羞耻的风险

object_relations.object_representation: Happier, better-prepared others with judgmental gazes (including other expectant parents)

object_relations.self_representation: 难以让伴侣满意的自责者
object_relations.object_representation: 难以理解自己感受的伴侣

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When invited to share pride about the pregnancy or asked about personal achievements
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 若表达自豪会被视为自夸或显得普通，从而被do not人negate
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: use谨慎、低调的语气，强调外在标准（如“应该”“必须”），淡化自我感受与成就。

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 当丈夫对其孕期情绪表示not理解或关系出现紧张时
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 把关系问题归结为自己not称职，认为自己正在失败（移情为自责）
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: use自我贬低与过度承担责任的表述，语气柔和并主动道歉。

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When reading others' pregnancy experiences online and making many social comparisons
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 以理性化的方式证明“怀孕并not特do not”，从而避免面对自卑与羞耻感
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Uses analytical, generalizing language (such as 'statistically almost everyone can get pregnant'), reducing emotional expression.

manifestations: 认为怀孕“几乎任何人都能做到”，因此not具独特性与意义，难以为自己感到自豪
Has support from father and husband, but finds it hard to open up to family about inferiority feelings related to pregnancy

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'.
manifestations: 以外部标准衡量自我是否“够特do not/够优秀”
用“应该/必须更特do not才值得自豪”的隐性规则评判自己

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: 难以承认自己的成就与价值

contact_model.definition: The individual suppresses emotional experiences, finds it hard to express and contact one's real feelings in the moment.
manifestations: 面对家人时难以表达关于怀孕的not足感与羞耻感
倾向理性化以替代情绪表达

exception_events.target_problem: 在进行怀孕相关准备或When comparing oneself with others，来访者通常会迅速产生自我not足并贬低自身成就，难以持续体验喜悦。
exception_events.unique_outcome: Once the client completed the nursery arrangement alone, and briefly felt proud and satisfied at that moment.
exception_events.reason: not同做法：独立完成具体任务；not同情境：成果可见且当下not yet与他人比较，从而出现短暂的积极体验。

positive_force: Has a supportive family (father and husband)
Willing to seek professional help and try new cognitive strategies
Able to complete concrete pregnancy-preparation tasks (such as setting up the nursery alone)
negative_force: Excessive social comparison and external-validation seeking
Self-worth depends on others' standards; prone to self-blame
难以向家人就not足感敞开表达

target_behavior.behavior: 自我照料与日常安排下降

Seeing or hearing others' more positive pregnancy experiences
